subject: QuickKart pilot: fit windowing, traffic profile & ramp proposal
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@quickkart.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request — QuickKart pilot idea (details attached)

Hi Karthik,

We signed up through the self-serve flow this morning and are interested in a short pilot to evaluate Redwood inference for a conversational checkout assistant + product recommendation flow. High level:
- Use case: conversational assistant at checkout (clarifying Qs, sku lookup, coupon application) and rank/recall for personalized recommender.
- Current traffic: ~5k requests/day to the cart/recommendation endpoints (spikes ~450 rps during peak), ~200k tokens/day total.
- Latency target: p95 < 300ms for the assistant where possible.
- Pilot goal: 6-week validation that latency & cost look reasonable before ramping to production in ~3 months.

Attached is a small traffic snapshot and a short doc with our must-haves (pilot_requirements.pdf). Curious on recommended model size and whether you prefer we deploy a short prefix cache or start with the default routing. Can we do a 30-minute demo+quick scoping call this week? Our engineer Priya Shah (cc'd) will be on the call.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Product, QuickKart
attachments: quickkart_traffic_snapshot.csv; pilot_requirements.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@quickkart.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — QuickKart pilot idea (details attached)

Samir — thanks for the writeup and the snapshot, this is helpful. A couple quick clarifying questions before we lock a slot so the demo is focused: 

1) Traffic shape: the CSV shows 450 rps peak for a short daily window — is that a single regional burst (east coast) or spread across regions?
2) Typical request size: average context length (tokens) for your assistant prompts + expected response length? An example prompt would help.
3) Success metrics for the 6-week pilot: do you want us to optimize primarily for latency (p95), or cost per completed transaction, or both? If both, please rank.
4) Auth / data controls: will you need Private deployment (VPC) / dedicated pool, or is hosted API acceptable for the pilot?

Proposed demo slots (we'll do a 30-minute scoping + live technical walk):
- Thu 2026-10-29 4:00pm PT
- Fri 2026-10-30 9:00am PT
- Fri 2026-10-30 3:00pm PT

If none of those work, send a Calendly link or I'll send an invite once we confirm. Marissa (cc) will join to cover pilot templates & success criteria.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@quickkart.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@quickkart.io>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — QuickKart pilot idea (details attached)

Thanks — quick answers inline: 
1) Peak is single-region (us-east) right now; we handle failover to us-west but traffic is concentrated.
2) Average context length is ~120 tokens; responses average ~80 tokens. Example prompt: 
"Cart total $87. Can I combine PROMO20 with loyalty points?"
3) Rank: 1) latency (p95) 2) cost per completed checkout.
4) Hosted API is fine for the pilot; we'll evaluate Dedicated after the validation.

Fri 3pm PT works for us (Priya + I). Can you send the invite? Also, can you include a short pre-demo checklist we can fill (model preferences, expected dataset samples, SSO/SOC2 questions)?

Date: 2026-10-30T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — QuickKart pilot idea (details attached)

All set — calendar invite sent for Fri 2026-10-30 at 3:00pm PT: https://calendar.redwood.com/b/quickkart-demo-30m

Pre-demo checklist (attached link + inline):
- Confirmed use case: conversational checkout assistant + recommender (as described).
- Traffic snapshot received (quickkart_traffic_snapshot.csv) — thanks.
- Pilot objectives: p95 latency < 300ms; cost benchmark target TBD after demo (we'll suggest target based on model selection).
- Data/access: hosted API OK for pilot; list required sample dataset (3–5 representative requests) and any PII redaction guidance.
- Security: link to SOC2 summary + SSO options included in invite.
- Pilot timeline: 6-week validation post-signing, production targeted in ~3 months.

Connor (cc) — can you prepare the default pilot config (batching settings, suggested quantization profile, and a canary rollout plan) so we can walk through during the call? Marissa will share the mutual action plan template immediately after the demo.

Samir / Priya — if you want to share one or two example prompts (anonymized) before the call that helps prioritize model size selection.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Karthik
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
